this_title: Being a Woman in Afghanistan: Hell on Earth
trans_title: ＢＳ世界のドキュメンタリー▽女性であるだけで　潜入ルポ抑圧の国アフガニスタン
introduction: We delve into the hell that has become the daily lives of women in Afghanistan since the Taliban returned to power in August 2021. In this documentary, the interweaving of social propaganda and real, immersive footage of Afghan’s women’s daily lives reveals the reality of Afghanistan’s gender apartheid, which is unlike anywhere else in the world.
